name: distribution_repair
scope: Apply all 82 supported fields for the registered 31 events. Three recipient cash amounts, 31 missing payment dates, 19 missing equity ex-reference cash values and one missing share-listing date change. Preserve original binary64 cash for the other 28 events under the unchanged 1e-12 rule. No account rounding, share ratio, provider identity or unscoped event changes.
binding: The accepted source review belongs to reviewed-resumption; runtime integration belongs to implemented-payments. Verify the complete 1839-event source-basis identity inventory, all 1448 previous supported fields and the 31 accepted field records. Each target's current action must exactly match its source-basis action; all 31 currently have no prior review member. Preserve every unscoped action and existing review. Freeze original/current identities and accepted source bindings in fact_bindings.json; never re-label the historical source review as current.
source_conflicts: Preserve the independent review's five initial primary failures and the unresolved Ingenic aggregate, plus all context anomalies. Only explicitly supported fields apply. Gross/reference display precision does not establish account rounding. Source support and conflicting aggregate status remain distinct.
cash_availability: Unchanged: first observed trading opening strictly after the declared payment date. Listing follows its separately declared date. No intraday funds availability is inferred.
implementation_scope: Only snapshots.py and semantic package version 0.28.0 may change among runtime modules. Add explicit acceptance/current-basis guards and an apply_verified_entitlements operation. Reuse the existing per-field cash conversion, original binary64 preservation and dataset construction. Keep legacy/default and date-only operation behavior exact. Model, feature, label, allocation, execution, ledger, risk and planning algorithms remain unchanged; numerical inputs may change as a consequence of corrected facts.
snapshot_validation: Before implementation preserve failing unsupported-operation and receipt/binding tests; cover omitted/duplicate/unaccepted fields, mismatched source/current identities, existing review protection and amount/reference separation. Bind successful source/field/context receipts without clearing historical source failures.

Rebuild the parent exactly before applying changes. Independently construct the 31 corrected actions and all expected field changes from accepted source facts, preserving 1808 unscoped actions, original opaque IDs, prior 1448 source fields and every old review. Check derived next-opening cash availability separately.

Independently rebuild affected price adjustment, wealth and local-gap paths from raw quotes and corrected entitlements, including recipient cash versus equity ex-reference semantics. Verify all other raw data, calendar, universe, eligibility, dated industry/fund metadata, opening status and share-ratio paths remain exact. Retain source limitations and reported fund mode.

Trace all action-dependent feature and score paths, then independently reconstruct affected features and whole-cross-section ranks. Check causal prefixes and unchanged fields across the complete snapshot, not only selected holdings. No profit-based choice of numeric policy or arbitrary float tolerance.

Independently review every affected eligible 1/3/5-day target and its exit/censoring metadata with raw openings, action dates, rational financial arithmetic and separately rounded original binary64 operations. Require equality after the original float32 target boundary; preserve ideal-decimal differences and all first failures. Do not assume labels remain unchanged merely because many gross cash values agree.

Freeze the accepted numeric scope and each fitting stage's rows, targets, features and weights before fitting. Fit inventory derives from the full actual range (currently 11 outer windows plus latest, 48 models and 24 fitting stages). Any unresolved independent numeric disagreement blocks training and activation, not the preservation of correct source facts.

compatibility.source_identity: Exercise ordinary guarded entry points with old inputs after implementation is final. Preserve original training/source identities and the 37730 baseline files; do not bypass guards or overwrite old results. Prove any later source edit's scope and revalidate affected compatibility.

attribution: First compare the current input against corrected inputs with fixed parent forecasts, then against fully refitted/recalibrated/selected forecasts. Report full ledger, settlement, label, feature and inner/outer quality differences; all 10/20/30bp paths, short-window distributions and same-input same-risk momentum. Do not demand old forecast/label equality for corrected amounts or select source facts by return direction.
status_and_exposure: Recheck ten sourced ST intervals, six opening-status records, dated industry coverage and reported ETF exposure. All signal/opening grouping and source-bound proxy limits stay unchanged; record remaining quality flags and passive exposure changes.
activation: Only after accepted field binding, independent action/feature/rank/label reconstruction, old-input compatibility, complete fitting, fixed forecasts and independent account/paper/status checks. Facts are accepted regardless of returns. Activate a consistent dataset/training/evaluation/configuration, then freeze a fresh next-session conditional plan without editing prior plans or inventing fills.
risk: Balanced attack, 8% warning, original high-water mark, latched non-recovering risk, existing stricter position cap; use the whitepaper for confirmed contest rules. No extra alpha candidates or relaxed gates.
limitations: 387 source events remain unverified; one scoped aggregate remains inconsistent. Field support is not certification of all financial terms, taxes, fractional allocation, settlement precision, archive completeness or original publication time.
Current-universe bias, exact historical publication times, other historical status and 111 quote-gap endpoints remain open.
Reported ETF proxy constraints do not certify complete daily economic exposure; economic upper bounds remain null.
Competition fees and matching details remain unconfirmed. No forward fill or return may be invented. Follow the whitepaper, 15% strategy cap and balanced attack with the original 8% latched warning.
